title: Parkersburg, WV — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Parkersburg, WV: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Parkersburg is a city in WV with a population of 30,000. Mid-Ohio Valley city with the Blennerhassett Island and a strong chemical industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
